propositions: transport.py repeatedly hits the 800 LOC cap, forcing reactive splits that do not provide new operations a determined home, causing the file to re-grow and repeat the cycle

The module's natural boundaries already exist as capability Protocols defined in _backend.py (TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe) but are not being used as the organizing principle
The method inventory clusters cleanly along capability seams: issues, hierarchy/parent, links, comments, people, and properties, each forming a self-contained mixin
Relocating code into capability mixins composed by a thin transport root keeps JiraDataCenterTransport as a single class satisfying the same Protocols with no call-site changes
The relocation produces five modules (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) all between 100–500 LOC with none exceeding the 800 cap
After the split, every future operation has a determined home by answering 'which capability is this?' rather than defaulting to the growth-prone god file
